cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: an archery range of targets on a green field — standing; a desert oasis at golden hour — standing; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; overgrown jungle temple ruins — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — standing; a foley recording booth with microphones and boxes of noisy props — holds a cup at chest height; a quiet spa lounge of robes — holds a cup at chest height; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — perched on a ledge or edge; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — sitting on the ground; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — standing; a sunlit white marble temple — standing; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table
